headline: 118 measures in 32 jurisdictions: new authority over AI or data centers for a government body
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

118 measures in 32 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

100 named offices would gain a power over AI. The one named most often is the Virginia Attorney General, in eight measures.

$85.2 million from 144 donors sits in five political committees working on AI policy.

2,272 measures tracked. 760 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
